faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Research Associate (RA) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Research Associate (RA) positions at IIT Kharagpur is 21st August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate (RA) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Mining Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, Geology, or Applied Geology. Additionally, they need at least two research papers published as the First Author in a Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate (RA) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate (RA) post is 35 years. However, age relaxation may be applicable based on sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate (RA) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate (RA) position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate (RA) post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Associate (RA) position announced by IIT Kharagpur in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the Research Associate (RA) recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Kharagpur Research Associate (RA) recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to visit the official website or the provided link to submit their applications.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job offered for the Research Associate (RA) position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Kharagpur located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur is located in Kharagpur, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this IIT Kharagpur Research Associate (RA) recruitment is IIT/SRIC/R/EAM/2026/102.
